nom: Clinique Blackhead Solutions 7 Day Deep Pore Cleanse & Face Scrub

segments.oily: Reviewers who identify as oily or oily-teenage-turned-adult report ongoing blackhead and breakout issues, with some seeing pore refinement and others seeing worsened oiliness or breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-combination skin generally say the product does not over-dry them and controls oil without stripping, though a couple mention flaking or dryness with extended use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including sensitive-combination and oily-combination) mostly report smaller pores and fewer blackheads, with one noting more breakouts when used twice daily as a cleanser instead of a mask.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say the scrub is gentle, non-irritating and doesn't dry or inflame their skin, while others (including one 75-year-old and a first-time user) report new breakouts or bumps within days of starting.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 40-52 report continued effectiveness against adult breakouts and blackheads without excess dryness, though one 75-year-old with sensitivity reacted badly and a 30-40 age-range reviewer with large pores found no deep effect.

concerns.aging: A few mature reviewers (40s-50s) mention using the product for ongoing adult acne and blackheads rather than for wrinkles or firmness specifically; no reviewer discusses anti-aging effects.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the product does not dry out or strip their skin and can be used with moisturizer follow-up; a minority describe flaking, dryness, or a slimy residue after use.
concerns.redness: Very few reviewers mention redness directly; one pairs the product with a soothing balm to prevent redness flare-ups from the salicylic acid, suggesting mild irritation potential for some.
concerns.barrier: Barrier complaints are rare; a couple of reviewers report increased sensitivity, flaking, or reactivity the day or two after use, while most describe the skin feeling smooth, soft, and comfortable.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers say exfoliation helped fade dark spots and improve overall skin appearance, though this is mentioned by only a small number and not universally confirmed.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts, cleared blackheads, and reduced pimples after consistent use (often citing 1-3 weeks); however, multiple reviewers describe new or worsened breakouts, cystic-type bumps, or no change at all, especially with frequent daily use as a cleanser.
concerns.oiliness: Some reviewers say the product controls oil and shrinks visible pores; others, particularly when used as a daily wash rather than a weekly mask, report skin becoming more oily or greasy-feeling.

aspects.libelle: Greasy or slimy residue on rinsing
Worse results with daily cleanser use vs weekly mask

extraits.texte: I am 75 - and unbelievably still have oily skin issues and breakouts along with sensitivity. I love the Acne Solution line but when I couldn't get the AS cleansing Mask, I ordered this. Within 2-3 uses as a Mask my skin started to break out creating little bumps on chin, nose and cheeks and forehead. Very strange but afraid to continue with it so will have to return. So hoping the old AS Mask will return soon!!!

extraits.titre: I really like it so far!
extraits.texte: I just used this product and instantly noticed my pores around my nostrils/ under eye near nose were smaller than I started. THIS IS NOT A CLEANSER!! Wash your face first please before any exfoliating product! I have sensitive combination skin and I didn't feel dried out or inflamed at all after using this product so I definitely will continue to use this every week!(cleared blackheads for me) I used this as a mask for 5 minutes and then scrubbed it into my skin before rinsing off and finished with a wet washcloth to ensure everything got off and then also followed with the moisture surge toner, moisturizer, and Laroche Posey's Cicaplast to make sure my redness wouldn't flare up from the salicylic acid. Overall really like this product so far!!

I got this to use as part of my daily routine because I have porous cheeks and blackheads call my nose/chin homebase. When I used this as my twice-a-day cleanser, I experienced more breakouts over the long term. I've since gone back to my normal combination-oily Clinique products and use this as a mask a few times a week and it works beautifully. I have yet to notice shrinking pores in 6 months, but my blackheads have had to find a new home. A few are still there, and probably will be forever, but this product has definitely helped manage it.

For 5 weeks I used this twice daily and it made the pores on my cheeks & nose look so much smaller. Now I use the mild liquid soap twice daily and this product as a 5-minute mask twice a week on my cheeks and nose. It makes my pores look smaller and less clogged. It's the best product I've ever used for my pores. I have dry combination skin & this product doesn't dry out my skin at all and manages to control the oil.

This scrub/mask is great. Light and creamy texture with tiny granules and not abrasive for scrubbing. I saw an instant improvement around my nose which is where my blackheads are. Great if you have acne which I also am prone to at 42. It doesn't leave my skin dry, no stripping feeling at all. I am very happy with this 7 day scrub.

This product is the best!!! I've been looking for an affordable, and effective face scrub/wash. I have sensitive skin and the scrub is gentle. I always had big pores near the sides of my nose and so many stubborn blackheads on my nose!! I've used everything for blackheads including the strips, that have not shown any results. I decided to buy this product since the reviews were good, I use this as a daily face wash once a day. On the third day i saw less blackheads on my nose! It has now been 2 weeks using this and my nose looks clear with less blackheads and my pores are much smaller. It also helps with my chin breakouts from wearing a mask all day. I highly recommend this product it really is effective on the face.

I ordered this face mask, I was very pleased. I have oily combination skin - this product is perfect for me. perfectly narrows pores, makes the skin clean and fresh. Thanks to Clinique for this amazing face wash product.
